run_scannet_publisher_main: run the main function to build a SparseVoxelMap for a ScanNet scene and publish voxel representations
build_sparse_voxel_map: build a SparseVoxelMap for a ScanNet scene using a SparseVoxelMapAgent model and ScanNetDataset
create_observations_from_scannet: create a list of Observations objects from ScanNet scene images, depths, poses, and intrinsics
publish_voxel_representation: publish voxel map representations to a directory using FilePublisher with model and observations
set_model_vocabulary: set the model vocabulary by mapping ScanNet class IDs to class names using dataset metadata
